sources.title: Local plans: preparing and examining a new style local plan (2026 regulations)
sources.role: Planning Inspectorate collection for new-style local plans under 2026 regulations
sources.facts: Published June 2026; applies to plans submitted for examination on or after 31 December 2026.
sources.guard: A process collection does not prove that an authority has submitted, passed examination or adopted a plan.

sources.title: Local plans: the examination process, new local plan system (2026 regulations)
sources.role: Guidance on examination under the new local-plan system
sources.facts: Explains the examination process and Planning Inspectorate role for plans submitted under the 2026 regulations.
sources.guard: Entering examination does not prove soundness, legal compliance, adoption or the status of a particular allocation.

sources.title: Local plans: the examination process legacy system
sources.role: Guidance for legacy-system local plan examinations
sources.facts: Explains submission, programme officer, hearings, Inspector reporting and adoption recommendations for legacy plans.
sources.guard: A hearing, examination list or Inspector recommendation must be checked against the final report and adoption record; it is not parcel permission.

sources.title: Procedure Guide for Local Plan Examinations
sources.role: July 2026 procedural guide for legacy local-plan examinations
sources.facts: Provides practical procedure, evidence-base currency considerations, monitoring-report expectations and examination administration.
sources.guard: Procedural compliance does not establish that evidence is current, the plan is sound or an allocation is deliverable.

sources.title: 30-month local plan process: an overview
sources.role: Overview of the new local-plan preparation, examination, adoption and monitoring process
sources.facts: Describes the intended stages and timing of the new plan-making system.
sources.guard: An indicative process or timetable does not prove actual milestone completion, adoption or legal effect.

sources.title: Publish your plan data
sources.role: Approved planning-data standard guidance under the Planning Data (England) Regulations 2026
sources.facts: Published in 2026; covers local-plan timetables, minerals and waste plan timetables and local-plan housing requirement data.
sources.guard: Publication in a prescribed format does not prove substantive accuracy, current status, soundness or adoption.

sources.title: Publishing your local plan housing requirement
sources.role: Guidance for publishing local-plan housing requirement data
sources.facts: Relates to the Planning Data (England) Regulations 2026 and the approved data standard.
sources.guard: A published requirement is not evidence of five-year supply, delivery, allocation, permission or site capacity.

sources.title: Publish your brownfield land data
sources.role: Current guidance for publishing and reviewing brownfield land registers
sources.facts: Requires authorities to publish structured data and review their brownfield land register at least annually.
sources.guard: Register inclusion is not planning permission, ownership, remediation completion, availability or deliverability.
